_keys_note: Discrete(11): 0-7 = compass (0=N,1=E,2=S,3=W,4=NE,5=SE,6=SW,7=NW), 8=OPEN, 9=KICK, 10=SEARCH. Arrows map to the cardinals; Y/A/B/X to the diagonals NW/NE/SW/SE; LT/RT/A+B to open/kick/search. turn_based:true is required -- noop is action 0 (=move N). Keep the message Controls text in sync with 'keys' by hand.
_curriculum_note: Blocking: the block is this task played until completed (mode 'episode', n_episodes 1, advancing_outcomes ['won']); a death or the env's own step limit restarts the same level, and max_duration 300 s is the cap. ESC is the experimenter's way out.

text: Explore the dark corridors between rooms and reach
the goal ( the down-staircase, > ). Open or kick
doors, and search walls for hidden passages.
ARROWS       move  N / S / W / E
Y / A        move diagonally  NW / NE
B / X        move diagonally  SW / SE
